parsedVerdict.reasoning: This is a presentation file, a NestJS controller. Its routing decorators (@Controller, @Post, @Get, @Body, @Param), its DTO parameter and its BadRequestException fit a delivery-layer component. However, OrderController.create also enforces an order invariant on its own: `if (dto.quantity <= 0) throw new BadRequestException('Quantity must be positive')`. The rule that an order's quantity must be positive is a domain invariant. The order entity or the application service should own it, not the HTTP controller. If OrderService.create or OrderEntity is called from anywhere else, such as a worker or another use case, this check is skipped, so the rule is enforced in only one place. Both candidate flags (controller logic density and controller business logic) point to this same block (lines 10-16), and the source supports them. findOne only delegates, so it is fine.
